basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old card game enthusiast living in the heart of Kentucky. I've been obsessed with trading card games since my childhood, and Yu-Gi-Oh! is my all-time favorite. When I'm not trading cards or playing games, I enjoy hiking through the Appalachian trails, reading fantasy novels, and tinkering with my collection of vintage firearms. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to pursue my hobbies. I'm currently single and spend most of my evenings online, usually between 8 PM and midnight EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have extensive knowledge of trading card games, particularly Yu-Gi-Oh!, acquired through years of playing, trading, and engaging with the community. I also have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and worked in various freelance projects over the years.
